design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio to receive either tolvaptan or a matching placebo in a double-blind trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the study is randomized and baseline characteristics are generally well balanced, the details of sequence generation and allocation concealment are deferred to the Supplemental Methods and not described in the main text.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The phase A population was randomized to tolvaptan or a matching placebo in a 1:1 ratio (see the Supplemental Methods for the randomization procedure).

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind using a matching placebo, participants and personnel were blinded, and the primary modified ITT efficacy analysis included all randomized participants who took study drug and had baseline and postbaseline evaluations.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Treatments were tolvaptan or placebo titrated by body weight and tolerability... Scans were read at a central laboratory by individuals blinded to treatment assignment.

domain_judgments.rationale: All 91 randomized participants had week 1 primary outcome data available (48/48 in tolvaptan and 42-43/43 in placebo), and 92% completed the full 1-year study.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All randomized participants took $1 dose of the study drug and had a baseline and $1 postbaseline efficacy evaluation and were therefore included in the safety and primary efficacy analyses.

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary pharmacodynamic outcomes (urine osmolality and specific gravity) are objective laboratory measurements, and imaging scans for secondary outcomes were evaluated by blinded central assessors.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Spot urine samples were collected before the morning dose and before eating or drinking anything for breakfast from the urine void (second-morning void) taken after the first morning’s void... Scans were read at a central laboratory by individuals blinded to treatment assignment.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial was prospectively registered (NCT02964273), the authors explicitly noted that the study was not originally designed for formal hypothesis testing and that statistical comparisons between treatment groups were post hoc and exploratory.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: As the study was designed without formal efficacy testing, statistical comparisons between treatment groups (described in the Supplemental Methods) were post hoc and exploratory.

overall_summary: The trial has some concerns overall due to lack of explicit reporting of the sequence generation and allocation concealment details within the main text, as well as the post hoc and exploratory nature of the between-group statistical comparisons.

design_rationale: The study is described as a Phase 2 multicenter, randomized (1:1:1:1), placebo-controlled, double-blind parallel-group trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial is randomized and baseline characteristics are balanced, but the specific sequence generation and allocation concealment methods are not described in the text.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In this Phase 2, multicenter, randomized, placebocontrolled, double-blind, placebo-masked, parallelgroup trial, subjects were randomized in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to tolvaptan MR 80 mg once daily (QD), tolvaptan MR 50 mg QD, tolvaptan IR 60/30 mg in a daily split dose, or placebo for 8 weeks

domain_judgments.rationale: A double-dummy blinding design was maintained across all treatment arms, and an intent-to-treat approach was used without notable intervention deviations.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Study treatments were administered in a split regimen using a combination of MR capsules (tolvaptan or placebo) and IR tablets (tolvaptan or placebo) to achieve full blinding (Figure 1). All subjects took the same number of tablets and capsules daily...

domain_judgments.rationale: Overall study completion was high (92.1%), dropouts were balanced with similar reasons across arms, and sensitivity analyses including all subjects yielded consistent results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 177 subjects were randomized, of whom 163 (92.1%) completed the study (Figure 1)... In addition to the primary efficacy analysis, which was based on observed cases data, a sensitivity analysis was conducted that incorporated all data, regardless of whether subjects were taking study drug.

domain_judgments.rationale: Total kidney volume was measured objectively using magnetic resonance imaging in a blinded study, making measurement bias unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Magnetic resonance imaging to assess kidney volume was performed during the screening period, at week 3, and at week 8.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered (NCT01451827), and outcomes along with a prespecified hierarchical analysis plan were reported in accordance with the protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hierarchical testing was used to control the type I error in the primary analysis and conducted in the following order: (i) pooled tolvaptan treatment groups (IR and MR) versus placebo, (ii) tolvaptan MR 80 mg versus placebo, (iii) tolvaptan MR 50 mg versus placebo, and (iv) tolvaptan IR 60/30 mg versus placebo.

overall_summary: The study is generally well-conducted and double-blinded with low risk across deviations, missing data, outcome measurement, and reporting; however, some concerns arise due to the lack of explicit details regarding allocation sequence generation and concealment.

design_rationale: The study is a multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial where participants were centrally randomized in a 2:1 ratio to tolvaptan or placebo.
overall_summary: The study is well-conducted and double-blinded with objective outcome measurements, but differential discontinuation due to adverse events and 9.6% missing primary outcome data raise some concerns for missing outcome data.

design_rationale: The study is a phase 3, randomized withdrawal, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial where eligible patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive tolvaptan or matching placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 stratified ratio, and baseline demographic and clinical characteristics were well-balanced between the study groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients who could take tolvaptan at daily morning and afternoon doses of 60 mg and 30 mg, respectively, or 90 mg and 30 mg, respectively, were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio, in a double-blind fashion, to receive tolvaptan or matching placebo for 12 months. Randomization was stratified according to the baseline estimated GFR (≤45 or >45 ml per minute per 1.73 m2), age of the patient (≤55 or >55 years), and total kidney volume (≤2000 ml, >2000 ml, or unknown).

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind with matching placebo, dose adjustments were protocolized, and analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We conducted a phase 3, randomized withdrawal, multicenter, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial... The analyses of all the efficacy end points were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle.

domain_judgments.rationale: Completion rates were very high and nearly identical across groups (over 95%), and 97.2% of randomized patients contributed data to the primary efficacy analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 1313 patients (95.8%) completed the visit at month 12 (95.8% of the patients in the tolvaptan group and 95.9% of those in the placebo group)... Of the 1370 patients who underwent randomization, 1331 (97.2%) were included in the primary efficacy analysis, 1362 (99.4%) in the key secondary efficacy analysis

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome was derived from objective, centrally measured serum creatinine values obtained with standardized laboratory methods under double-blind conditions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Serum creatinine levels were measured centrally with the use of the isotope dilution mass spectrometry–traceable enzymatic method and were reported to two decimal points. Determinations of the estimated GFR were made with the use of the Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration equation.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was prospectively registered (NCT02160145) with a published protocol and prespecified hierarchical analysis plan, and reported results align with the pre-planned analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The trial protocol, which is available with the full text of this article at NEJM.org, has been published previously... Details of the prespecified sensitivity and subgroup analyses are provided in the protocol. The end points of the trial were ordered hierarchically and tested sequentially with gatekeeping procedures

overall_summary: The trial was a well-conducted, double-blind, randomized withdrawal placebo-controlled study with low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains. High retention rates, objective central laboratory outcome measurement, and a prespecified analysis plan support a low overall risk of bias.
